metadata.candidateDescription: complete-snapshot implementation; sourceCommit names candidate, candidate.patch records any tracked build-time differences
metadata.profile: release, tauri/custom-protocol, no E2E hooks, default recovery features
metadata.display: isolated Xvfb + Openbox, 1200x800, X11; not the interactive Wayland compositor
metadata.cachePolicy: OS caches uncontrolled; 2 excluded warm-up launches per directory; fresh process, same isolated app profile per scenario
metadata.endpoint: native receipt after settings, commands, initial listing and two animation-frame opportunities; not externally observed presented pixels or input
metadata.statistics: nearest-rank p50/p95; 20 measured samples per group, 2 excluded warmups; alternating AB/BA order

interaction.method: Separate native release WebDriver runs; exact-app fork shim; 100000 files; full count and Ctrl+End final selected row required. rAF and summed RSS are proxies, not compositor frames/PSS.
